data.title: 桃乐丝 · 拱廊前的清晨迎接
data.description: 桃乐丝穿白色长袖连衣裙和浅粉外套，站在伊甸入口的石质拱廊前，双手交叠在身前轻轻颔首。高大的白色石柱与一排拱券构成清楚的建筑纵深，紫色眼睛中的微笑克制周到，晨光柔和照亮她的面部。
data.action: 双手交叠在身前，朝入口轻轻颔首。
data.promptProse: Dorothy stands at Eden's stone entrance arcade in an opaque white long-sleeved dress and pale-pink jacket, both hands folded as she inclines her head. Long pink hair and the side bun frame a restrained violet-eyed welcome. The medium portrait follows pale columns and rounded arches toward garden greenery beyond. Soft frontal morning light illuminates her face and gesture, with recessed arch shadows establishing architectural depth behind her.
